about: The main Redis client for Go, a programming language, used to talk to the Redis data store.

prs.title: Search results with scores and no content now come back right
prs.broken: With the older protocol, a search that asked for scores or sort keys but no content returned scores as if they were documents, and asking for payloads made the call fail.
prs.changed: The client now reads those per-document values first and steps over empty payloads.
prs.matters: Programs that rank search results by score get the right documents.
